title: The ℓ¹-Bass Conjecture for Discrete Groups
summary: We prove the ℓ 1 -Bass conjecture for every discrete group. The Hattori–Stallings trace of every idempotent matrix over the complex ℓ 1 group algebra is supported on finitely many conjugacy classes of finite-order elements.
family_title: The ℓ¹-Bass conjecture for all discrete groups
